wave: 3C - the coverage gaps the Wave 2 hunt recorded and never executed

gaps.note: three copies of one auth rule, two with no environment guard; one definition now, fail-closed on absence. Deployment reachability remains open and is NOT claimed.

gaps.gap: (consequence of W3C-01) 182 tests authenticated through the bypass
gaps.note: a refusal proven by a superset actor is stronger, not weaker. Corrects my own overstatement.

gaps.gap: pricing-quote: no effective-window check, client-supplied coupon
gaps.note: the window check is present (the note was wrong); the coupon has no money path because resolveLivePrice passes none and the route writes nothing. Both properties now pinned.

gaps.gap: IST-vs-UTC day boundary, never driven to a consequence
gaps.note: sharper than recorded - the divergence is inside ONE function. A provider at their daily cap on the IST service day was returned with capacity:true.

gaps.gap: food/relocation/funeral never exercised; 'likely share the resolveLivePrice defect'
gaps.note: none calls resolveLivePrice; relocation and funeral carry no price at all; Food pins item_version so a repriced catalogue makes the stale quote unconvertible rather than silently repricing.

prepareReferralBooking only READS - the caller batches the write - so the UNIQUE(programme_id,referred_customer_id) index is indeed the only thing closing the window, and it holds. Recorded unfixed: the losing caller gets a generic 500 rather than a governed 409, a diagnostics nit of the same class as taxi-proof's 404 body.

gaps.gap: runAppFunnelSweep abandonMinutes collapses -5 to a 1-minute window
gaps.note: -5 is truthy so `|| DEFAULT` never fired and Math.max floored it at 1. No caller passes it today, which is why it was never reached - but 'no caller today' is not a control.

not_claimed: Three gaps recorded by the hunt remain genuinely out of reach here and are NOT probed: real Cloudflare D1 semantics (every probe runs against a node:sqlite shim), the deployed edge path (worker/index.ts needs a Workers runtime), and every external provider, none of which has a credential in any environment.
True parallelism was not exercised. TRAP-A1 models the referral race by issuing both writes against one database, which reproduces the index's decision but not the timing window's width.
